spec_provided_observability.name: Bus / superframe lock status (per node)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Indicates whether each sub node has achieved clock recovery and superframe lock; loss of lock is reported upstream.

spec_provided_observability.name: Line-fault diagnostics (per segment)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Detect and localize cable open, short to ground, short to battery, short across the pair, and reversed wiring.

spec_provided_observability.name: Phantom-power fault status (per segment)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Over-current / under-voltage detection on each powered segment.

spec_provided_observability.name: Interrupt status registers
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Aggregate sub-node interrupts upstream so the host can read the source and node of any fault over tunneled I2C.

spec_provided_observability.name: Discovery status / node count
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Track how many nodes were discovered and where discovery stopped if it failed.

spec_provided_observability.name: Data-decoding / CRC error indicators
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Flag corruption of the superframe control structure.

interrupt_sources.trigger: Master detected arbitration loss on SDA.
Receiver returned NACK when ACK expected.
Illegal condition (START or STOP at unexpected position).

interrupt_request: Interrupts are SoC-controller-specific; UM10204 lists the canonical conditions observable at the protocol layer.
notes: A2B diagnostics let the host localize a fault to a specific segment / node, which is essential for serviceability of a vehicle audio harness. Concrete AD24xx parts expose these as interrupt mask/status and diagnostic registers reached over (tunneled) I2C.
